Well I bought this game almost 7 years ago and I finally decided to play through it. I really need to stop buying games...

The short and sweet: It is an enjoyable shooter, albeit quite short. I would NOT recommend this at a 30 USD price tag, a hard maybe at 20 and a purchase at 10 USD.

Play time: Normal difficulty playthough was maybe 5 hours and done in a single sitting. 

Story: It is there, but it is really just a means to give you a reason to murder orks around 3500 of them a playthrough. 

Graphics: The game is 7 years old, but it still looks pretty good.

Level design is lacking, there are a lot of long pointless hallways/tunnels.

The movement feels slow and cumbersome, but I suppose you're in a giant suit of armor, the few times you get a jet pack are nice though. 

3 potatoes out of 5

Right...Stop playing Enternal Crusade and get yer tailfeather on this absolute gem of a 40K game, Space Marine has hand down the best pvp and horde mode [called Exterminatus don't you know] you'll ever need, yes you can't play as da Orks, Eldar or other 40K usual suspects a side from Chaos legions of which you'll have access to each and every traitor legion as well as the loyalist [Black Legion and Salamaders for me]; now you have to put in the kills and grind to get better guns and perks, guns unlock with each level up [cap is Lv 41] kills open up your perks I'm level 9 and have a melta gun, stalker pattern bolter, plasma gun, power sword+Axe, blind grenades, and combat stims!

Bolter, frag grenade, heavybolter, bolt pistol, chain sword, and jump pack come as beginning weapons/armour suit, but with perks you can do more damage or get perks for armour e.g take more damage CQC or ranged attacks, create blow back from the jumpack engine should you need a quick exit from being surrounded and want to do some damage, and most of all you boost down slam the same enemies in green messes on yer boot.

Downsides are the migration swapping happens a fair bit in pvp which can be a pain in the bum and folks only come online in afternoon/evenings but once there on, its kicking off royal, okay there aren't any vehicles but infantry combat is more than enough. Without perks your still going to get kills in pvp so don't stress and you can level on either pvp or horde mode [horde mode levels faster I feel] and the single player campaign is 40k from tip to toe.

Just stop playing enternal crusade, come on this game and have some fun...oh by the way you can customize each piece of your power armour and gain access to different patterns/Mk.'s.
